title: Chard Leaves Stuffed with Brown Rice and Millet
subtitle: with lentils, almonds and a coconut tomato sauce
description: Chard leaves filled with a mix of brown rice, millet, red lentils, carrot and almonds, then simmered in a spicy tomato and coconut sauce. Fresh millet matters, since old millet tastes bitter.

steps.text: For the filling, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a pot and fry 1 chopped onion for 5 minutes until golden. Add 2 chopped garlic cloves, the ginger, carrot strips, lentils, rice, millet, 3 cups water, parsley, curry powder, almonds, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook covered for 40 minutes until the rice is ready. Cool.

Meanwhile make the sauce. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a deep wide frying pan and fry the remaining finely chopped onion for 5 minutes until golden. Add the remaining garlic and the chilli and fry for a few seconds.
Add the tomato sauce, coconut milk, 2 cups water, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook for 4 minutes to combine the flavours.
Blanch the chard leaves in a pot of boiling water for 1 minute. Spread on a towel and cut out the thick stems with a knife.
Fill each chard leaf with 2 to 3 tablespoons of filling (depending on size), roll up and place in the pan with the sauce.
Bring the pan to the boil and cook for about 2 minutes over high heat until the sauce reduces slightly. Serve hot.
